description: Describes the transport parameters of a Receiver of urn:x-padl:transport:ieee1722, an IEEE 1722 listener stream (a STREAM_INPUT of an IEEE 1722.1 entity; Milan is the profile presented), which is patched by binding it to a talker stream. The constraints in this schema are minimum constraints, but may be further constrained at the constraints endpoint. IEEE 1722 Receivers must support all parameters in this schema.
title: IEEE 1722 Receiver Transport Parameters

entity_id.description: Entity ID of the talker the listener is bound to as IEEE 1722.1 writes an EUI-64: 16 hexadecimal digits, optionally prefixed by 0x. Senders report 16 lowercase digits; a Receiver also accepts fewer digits, with leading zeros left out. Zero is not an entity ID. A null value indicates that the listener is not bound.

stream_index.description: Index of the talker's STREAM_OUTPUT descriptor. A null value indicates that the listener is not bound.
